convert_spring_dataset_to_wai: run the spring conversion script to convert a Spring dataset to WAI format using the spring.yaml config
load_spring_extrinsics: load Spring camera extrinsics from a text file and return 4x4 transformation matrices as a numpy array
load_spring_intrinsics: load Spring camera intrinsics from a text file and return 3x3 intrinsic matrices as a numpy array
load_spring_depth: load Spring metric depth from a dsp5 disparity file using camera intrinsics and a baseline distance
process_spring_scene: process a single Spring scene into WAI format with depth maps, skymasks, and camera metadata
